name: Anata no Tonari de Yureru Jikan
original_name: あなたの隣で揺れる時間
source: When you were a kid, you made a wish to have a boyfriend before your 18th birthday. The day's almost come and your wish hasn't come true yet. Will you be able to fulfill it and find love?
translation: When you were a kid, you made a wish to have a boyfriend before your 18th birthday. The day's almost come and your wish hasn't come true yet. Will you be able to fulfill it and find love?
